scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

selector_identity.flags: DDEBUG_DEFAULT exact current C preprocessing rule

existing_log_provider: Existing production Rust debug::kprintf via existing C variadic symbol kprintf; identical pattern as sched_helpers::process_sched_migrate_log_bridge
existing_selector_ABI: crate::debug::Ddebug repr(C), no guessed offsets or references
variadic_arguments: Original C VmRange.flag is unsigned long even for %x; keep CULong in Rust, preserve actual machine ABI and formatter behavior.
ordering: Unknown event reads no pointers/selector; overlap unconditional reads fields and calls once; success reads dynamic flags first and only evaluates fields/calls when nonzero.
lifetime: Raw borrowed VM/range pointers retained only through synchronous kprintf; no allocation/free/locks/refcount changes. No Rust references to VM/ranges constructed.
remaining_C_debt: Other remaining VM range bodies/callbacks; no whole area/file claim
failure_family_history: New diagnostic body source family; prior process-entry observer failure/correction remains retained and is not reset.
